items.reasons: Both amendments pass the two portable-template tests in memory. However, both change the manifest-pinned template. A specifies no manifest update; B labels its update non-blocking, rather than required in the same commit. Under the stated effective-resolution rule, neither includes the necessary refresh. Applied exactly, both therefore fail hash and byte-count validation.

That still fails validation. A's no-edit resolution preserves consistency.
